name: Salvage Crate
text: Scrap hauled out of the yard and sorted. Mostly common stock.
_rates: Weights are out of 1000 and MUST be shown to the player. Several jurisdictions require published gacha odds, and every store's policy does.

name: Foundry Crate
text: Pulled from a working line rather than a scrap heap. Better stock, real cost.

name: Reclaimer Cache
text: Ten pulls at once, with one rarity 2 or better guaranteed.
